title: Fonctions L / Équation fonctionnelle des fonctions L (cas géométrique) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page has nothing to do with the L-function computations on the preceding pages. It is a typed sheet headed '6 - 32 -' and 'n° 392', consistent with a page of a Bourbaki draft (rédaction) misfiled at the end of cote 60. The 'n° 392' format and the old Bourbaki term 'élément extrémal' for an irreducible element suggest Bourbaki, but the exact chapter and draft number are unverified. It contains exercise 26 on factorial rings.

Setting: A is a UFD with fraction field K, B = A[X_1,...,X_n], and f_1,...,f_r are elements of B. Claim: the f_i generate the unit ideal of B if and only if both of the following hold.
(i) The f_i generate the unit ideal of K[X], i.e. there are v_i in K[X] with sum v_i f_i = 1.
(ii) Write v_i = w_i/d with d in A, the w_i in A[X], and the content (gcd of all coefficients of all w_i) equal to 1. Then for every irreducible p of A dividing d, the images of the f_i generate (A/pA)[X].

Necessity: take v_i in B and d = 1. The content condition holds automatically, since a prime dividing every coefficient of every v_i would divide 1. There is then no prime dividing d, so (ii) is vacuous.

Sufficiency: let I = sum B f_i. Then d = sum w_i f_i lies in I. Write d = u p_1^{a_1}...p_k^{a_k}. By hypothesis I + p_j B = B for each j. Raising to powers gives I + p_j^{a_j} B = B. Comaximality is preserved under products, so I + dB = B. Since d is in I, this gives I = B.

The exercise reduces the unit-ideal question over A[X] to the field K plus finitely many residue rings (A/p)[X], a standard local-global / denominator-clearing argument.
errors: No mathematical error. The content-1 normalization of the w_i is not needed for sufficiency: any common denominator d works. It only makes d essentially minimal, so the set of primes to check is as small as possible.
Minor phrasing issue: condition (ii) is stated as 'si l'on pose v_i = w_i/d ...'. It should be read as applying to the normalized representation, which is unique up to units.

ideas.what: Criterion for f_i to generate the unit ideal in A[X_1..X_n] over a UFD: unit ideal over K[X] plus unit ideal modulo each prime dividing the reduced common denominator
ideas.modern_name: Unimodularity / comaximality test via clearing denominators and reduction mod primes (local-global for the unit ideal)
